description.value: In 1911, Shackleton led the first expedition across Antarctica. His ship, the Endurance, became locked in ice where for nine months Shackleton and his men battled the elements before their ship was crushed by the ice. They trekked across ice floes and finally found their way to the South Georgia Island.
